fixes.title: Group the amount and due date
fixes.finding: The spacing separates the due date from the amount it describes and pushes the payment action further down.

fixes.title: Remove the repeated introduction
fixes.finding: The pill and introduction repeat the invoice heading without explaining what to do or when payment is due.

fixes.title: Move payment above support
fixes.finding: The support link appears before the main action. Put payment next to the amount and due date so the reading and tab order match the task.

fixes.title: Name the payment action
fixes.finding: Continue gives no indication of the next step. The payment button opens the payment flow.
